reward_contract.scalar: binary semantic correctness of one extracted Python artifact
accepted_artifacts: one complete enclosing python or unlabelled Markdown fence
reward_contract.formatting_compliant: recorded separately and excluded from scalar reward

retention.artifact_contract: same v2 extraction before unchanged v1 interpreter verification
retention.generation_budget: same 128 generated-token and context policy as primary comparison
retention.decision_rule: report all outcomes; do not tune, repeat, or select based on retention results
